Mobile app for field sales reps

Reps take orders even offline, see each client's balance and send shelf photos, and everything lands in 1C. Qilich builds the MVP in 8–12 weeks, from UZS 144 mln; the full version in 16–26 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes

  • Visit plan

What the full version adds
  • Van sales with receipt printing
  • Returns

  • Self-ordering app for client shops

Questions

What does “Mobile app for field sales reps” cost?

How long does “Mobile app for field sales reps” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 8–12 weeks and the full version in 16–26 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Mobile app for field sales reps”?
